plain: Rent is $1,450 a month.
legal: The monthly rent shall be $1,450.

plain: The security deposit is one month's rent.
legal: The Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to one (1) month's rent.

plain: You'll get your deposit back within 30 days after moving out, minus any repair costs.
legal: The Landlord shall return the security deposit within thirty (30) days following the end of the tenancy, less the cost of any repairs required.

plain: No pets allowed.
legal: The keeping of pets on the Premises is not permitted.

plain: You can have one cat if you pay an extra $25 a month.
legal: The Tenant may keep one (1) cat on the Premises subject to payment of an additional $25 per month.

plain: Don't smoke inside the apartment.
legal: Smoking is prohibited within the Apartment.

plain: You can't sublet without the landlord's written permission.
legal: The Tenant shall not sublet the Premises without the prior written consent of the Landlord.

plain: The landlord has to give you 24 hours' notice before coming in, except in emergencies.
legal: Except in an emergency, the Landlord shall give the Tenant not less than twenty-four (24) hours' notice prior to entering the Premises.

plain: The tenant pays for electricity, gas and internet.
legal: The Tenant shall be responsible for the payment of all charges for electricity, gas and internet services.

plain: Water and trash collection are included in the rent.
legal: The rent shall include charges for water supply and refuse collection.

plain: Tell the landlord about any repairs needed as soon as possible.
legal: The Tenant shall notify the Landlord of any required repairs as soon as reasonably practicable.

plain: The landlord fixes major things like the roof and the boiler.
legal: The Landlord shall be responsible for major repairs, including repairs to the roof and the boiler.

plain: The tenant handles small things like changing light bulbs.
legal: The Tenant shall be responsible for minor maintenance, such as the replacement of light bulbs.

plain: You can't paint the walls without asking first.
legal: The Tenant shall not paint the walls without the Landlord's prior consent.

plain: Leave the place clean when you move out.
legal: Upon vacating the Premises, the Tenant shall leave them in a clean condition.

plain: Normal wear and tear won't be deducted from your deposit.
legal: No deduction shall be made from the security deposit in respect of fair wear and tear.

plain: Quiet hours are from 10 pm to 7 am.
legal: Quiet hours shall be observed between 10 pm and 7 am.

plain: Only the people named on the lease can live here.
legal: The Premises shall be occupied only by the persons named in this Lease.

plain: Guests can stay for up to 14 nights in a row.
legal: Guests may stay at the Premises for a maximum of fourteen (14) consecutive nights.

plain: Rent goes up by 3% each year on the lease anniversary.
legal: The rent shall increase by 3% on each anniversary of the commencement date.

plain: If rent is more than 5 days late, there's a $50 late fee.
legal: A late fee of $50 shall be charged if rent remains unpaid more than five (5) days after its due date.

plain: The landlord will paint the apartment before you move in.
legal: The Landlord shall repaint the Apartment prior to the commencement of the tenancy.

plain: There's one parking space included, number 14.
legal: The Lease includes the use of one (1) parking space, designated as number 14.

plain: Bikes must be kept in the storage room, not in the hallway.
legal: Bicycles shall be stored in the designated storage room and shall not be left in the hallway.

plain: You need renters insurance for the whole lease.
legal: The Tenant shall maintain renters insurance for the entire term of the Lease.

plain: The landlord can show the apartment to new renters in the last 30 days of the lease.
legal: During the final thirty (30) days of the term, the Landlord may show the Apartment to prospective tenants.

plain: You can't run a business from the apartment.
legal: The Premises shall not be used for the conduct of any business.

plain: If the place becomes unlivable because of a fire, you don't pay rent until it's fixed.
legal: If the Premises are rendered uninhabitable by fire, rent shall abate until the Premises have been restored.

plain: The garden is shared with the downstairs tenant.
legal: The garden shall be shared with the tenant of the ground-floor unit.

plain: Keep the garden tidy and mow the lawn every two weeks in summer.
legal: The Tenant shall keep the garden tidy and mow the lawn every two (2) weeks during the summer months.

plain: Changing the locks isn't allowed unless the landlord gets a key.
legal: The Tenant shall not change the locks unless a copy of the new key is provided to the Landlord.

plain: The office lease is for 5 years, starting January 1, 2027.
legal: The term of the office lease shall be five (5) years, commencing on January 1, 2027.

plain: The tenant has the option to renew for another 5 years.
legal: The Tenant shall have an option to renew the Lease for a further term of five (5) years.

plain: The tenant must use the option to renew at least 6 months before the lease ends.
legal: The Tenant shall exercise the option to renew not less than six (6) months prior to the expiry of the Lease.

plain: The space can only be used as a dental clinic.
legal: The Premises shall be used solely as a dental clinic.

plain: The tenant can put a sign on the front door if the landlord approves the design.
legal: The Tenant may install signage on the front door, subject to the Landlord's approval of the design.

plain: Service charges are split based on floor area.
legal: Service charges shall be apportioned according to the floor area occupied by each tenant.

plain: Any changes to the building structure need the landlord's consent.
legal: No structural alterations shall be made to the Building without the Landlord's consent.

plain: At the end of the lease, remove anything you installed unless we agree otherwise.
legal: Upon expiry of the Lease, the Tenant shall remove all installations made by the Tenant unless otherwise agreed by the Parties.

plain: The seller will leave the kitchen appliances in the house.
legal: The Seller shall leave all kitchen appliances in the Property.

plain: The sale closes on August 15, 2027.
legal: Completion of the sale shall take place on August 15, 2027.

plain: The buyer pays a 10% deposit when signing the contract.
legal: The Buyer shall pay a deposit of 10% of the purchase price upon signing this Contract.

plain: The sale depends on the buyer getting a mortgage within 45 days.
legal: This sale is conditional upon the Buyer obtaining mortgage financing within forty-five (45) days.

plain: If the buyer can't get a mortgage, the deposit is returned.
legal: If the Buyer is unable to obtain mortgage financing, the deposit shall be refunded to the Buyer.

plain: The buyer can inspect the house before closing.
legal: The Buyer shall be entitled to inspect the Property prior to completion.

plain: Property taxes will be split between buyer and seller as of the closing date.
legal: Property taxes shall be apportioned between the Buyer and the Seller as at the date of completion.

plain: The house is sold with no tenants living in it.
legal: The Property shall be sold with vacant possession.

plain: The neighbor has a right to walk across the back path.
legal: The Property is subject to a right of way in favor of the adjoining owner over the rear path.

plain: Holiday rental guests must check out by 11 am.
legal: Guests shall vacate the Property no later than 11 am on the day of departure.

plain: No parties or events allowed at the rental.
legal: Parties and events are strictly prohibited at the Property.

plain: The maximum number of guests is 6.
legal: The Property shall not be occupied by more than six (6) guests.

plain: A $300 damage deposit is held on your card and released after checkout.
legal: A damage deposit of $300 shall be held on the Guest's payment card and released following checkout.

plain: Hot tub use is at your own risk; children must be supervised.
legal: Use of the hot tub is at the Guest's own risk, and children shall be supervised at all times.

plain: The landlord will reply to repair requests within 3 business days.
legal: The Landlord shall respond to any repair request within three (3) business days.

plain: Urgent repairs like a burst pipe will be handled within 24 hours.
legal: Urgent repairs, such as a burst pipe, shall be attended to within twenty-four (24) hours.

plain: If you leave before the lease ends, you pay rent until someone new moves in.
legal: If the Tenant vacates the Premises before the expiry of the Lease, the Tenant shall remain liable for rent until a replacement tenant takes occupancy.

plain: The landlord will try to find a new tenant quickly.
legal: The Landlord shall use reasonable efforts to re-let the Premises promptly.

plain: Hanging laundry from the balcony is not allowed.
legal: Laundry shall not be hung from the balcony.

plain: Barbecues are only allowed in the shared courtyard.
legal: Barbecues shall be permitted only in the communal courtyard.

plain: Report any pest problems to the building manager.
legal: Any pest infestation shall be reported to the Building Manager.
